programmes.name_local: Rwanda Development Board / ICT Chamber innovation and startup support
programmes.name_en: Rwanda Development Board / ICT Chamber innovation and startup support
programmes.funder: Rwanda Development Board (RDB) and the Ministry of ICT and Innovation
programmes.amount_note: Rwanda supports startups mainly through facilitation (fast company registration, Kigali Innovation City, 250 Startups accelerator, Norrsken Kigali hub) and periodic innovation challenge funds, rather than a standing cash grant scheme.
programmes.deadline_note: Support is delivered through specific initiatives and challenge calls announced by RDB, the Ministry of ICT and Innovation and partner hubs.
programmes.reopen_note: Rwanda's startup support is programme-driven. Watch rdb.rw, minict.gov.rw and the Rwanda ICT Chamber for open calls such as the Innovation Fund windows and 250 Startups cohorts.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the company in Rwanda (online, typically within days).
Monitor RDB and ICT Chamber channels for open challenges or accelerator cohorts.

eligibility.other_note: Rwandan-registered companies; several programmes explicitly welcome foreign founders relocating to Kigali.

programmes.funder: Rwanda Innovation Fund, managed by Angaza Capital with the Government of Rwanda and the African Development Bank
programmes.amount_note: A USD 100 million target venture fund investing growth capital in technology-enabled companies in Rwanda and across Africa, with tickets commonly from a few hundred thousand up to several million US dollars.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling investment enquiries; no fixed calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the company through the RIF website or an introduction.
Investment agreement, usually with a Rwandan presence commitment.

eligibility.other_note: Technology-enabled African companies; a Rwandan nexus or willingness to establish one is expected.
